text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while, Nakayama. What
business does
a goody-two-shoes Tracen
student have here?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm here just to test my skill... You'll run
with me,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Yeah, sure. I'll run... 2,400 meters,
just like
last time!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're keeping up with me?! I bet you'll
just
exhaust yourself, though!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(I know exactly what she's thinking. She
wants me
to believe she's got me.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... How'd you get so fast at the end? Agh!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Every day's a battle for me. I can't afford
to stay
the same.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're definitely not getting any
weaker.
Your endurance has improved a
lot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess I can chalk that up to being a

"goody-two-shoes" and following my
trainer's
instructions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I arrive at the track, I see
Nakayama Festa
has already started
training without me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's approving of my instruction
methods! I
guess she's starting to notice
that she's improved.
